verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם שְׁמַ֤ע יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־ הַחֻקִּ֣ים וְאֶת־ הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י דֹּבֵ֥ר בְּאָזְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם וּלְמַדְתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔ם וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם לַעֲשֹׂתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā mō·šeh ’el- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem šə·ma‘ yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- ha·ḥuq·qîm wə·’eṯ- ham·miš·pā·ṭîm ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî dō·ḇêr bə·’ā·zə·nê·ḵem hay·yō·wm ū·lə·maḏ·tem ’ō·ṯām ū·šə·mar·tem la·‘ă·śō·ṯām
verses.literal: Then Moses summoned all Israel and said . . . to them Hear O Israel the statutes and ordinances that I declare in your hearing this day Learn them and observe them carefully

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ כָּרַ֥ת עִמָּ֛נוּ בְּרִ֖ית בְּחֹרֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū kā·raṯ ‘im·mā·nū bə·rîṯ bə·ḥō·rêḇ
verses.literal: The LORD our God made a covenant with us at Horeb

verses.original: לֹ֣א אֶת־ אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ כָּרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֑את כִּ֣י אִתָּ֗נוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ אֵ֥לֶּה פֹ֛ה הַיּ֖וֹם כֻּלָּ֥נוּ חַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lō ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū kā·raṯ Yah·weh ’eṯ- hab·bə·rîṯ haz·zōṯ kî ’it·tā·nū ’ă·naḥ·nū ’êl·leh p̄ōh hay·yō·wm kul·lā·nū ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: He did not make this covenant with our fathers but with . . . . . . all of us who are alive here today . . .

verses.original: פָּנִ֣ים׀ בְּפָנִ֗ים דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה עִמָּכֶ֛ם בָּהָ֖ר מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: pā·nîm bə·p̄ā·nîm dib·ber Yah·weh ‘im·mā·ḵem bā·hār mit·tō·wḵ hā·’êš
verses.literal: The LORD spoke with you face to face out of the fire on the mountain

verses.original: אָ֠נֹכִי עֹמֵ֨ד בֵּין־ יְהוָ֤ה וּבֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא לְהַגִּ֥יד לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־ דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י יְרֵאתֶם֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָאֵ֔שׁ וְלֹֽא־ עֲלִיתֶ֥ם בָּהָ֖ר לֵאמֹֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî ‘ō·mêḏ bên- Yah·weh ū·ḇê·nê·ḵem bā·‘êṯ ha·hi·w lə·hag·gîḏ lā·ḵem ’eṯ- də·ḇar Yah·weh kî yə·rê·ṯem mip·pə·nê hā·’êš wə·lō- ‘ă·lî·ṯem bā·hār lê·mōr
verses.literal: At that time I was standing between the LORD and you to declare to you the word of the LORD because you were afraid of the fire and would not go up the mountain And He said

verses.original: אָֽנֹכִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצֵאתִ֛יךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִֽ֑ים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯî·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim mib·bēṯ ʿă·ḇå̄·ḏīm
verses.literal: I am the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt out of the house of slavery

verses.original: לֹ֣א יִהְיֶ֥ה־ לְךָ֛֩ אֱלֹהִ֥֨ים אֲחֵרִ֖֜ים עַל־ פָּנָֽ֗יַ׃
verses.transliteration: lō yih·yeh- lə·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm ‘al- pā·nā·ya
verses.literal: You shall have no other gods before Me

verses.transliteration: lō- ṯa·‘ă·śeh- lə·ḵā p̄e·sel kāl- tə·mū·nāh ’ă·šer baš·šā·ma·yim mim·ma·‘al wa·’ă·šer bā·’ā·reṣ mit·tā·ḥaṯ wa·’ă·šer bam·ma·yim mit·ta·ḥaṯ lā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above on the earth below or in the waters beneath

verses.original: לֹא־ תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥֣ה לָהֶ֖ם֮ וְלֹ֣א תָעָבְדֵ֑ם֒ כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֞י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֵ֣ל קַנָּ֔א פֹּ֠קֵד עֲוֺ֨ן אָב֧וֹת עַל־ בָּנִ֛ים וְעַל־ שִׁלֵּשִׁ֥ים וְעַל־ רִבֵּעִ֖ים לְשֹׂנְאָֽ֑י׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯiš·ta·ḥă·weh lā·hem wə·lō ṯā·‘ā·ḇə·ḏêm kî ’ā·nō·ḵî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’êl qan·nā pō·qêḏ ‘ă·wōn ’ā·ḇō·wṯ ‘al- bā·nîm wə·‘al- šil·lê·šîm wə·‘al- rib·bê·‘îm lə·śō·nə·ʾå̄y
verses.literal: You shall not bow down to them . . . or worship them for I the LORD your God am a jealous God visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children . . . to the third . . . and fourth generations of those who hate Me

verses.original: וְעֹ֤֥שֶׂה חֶ֖֙סֶד֙ לַֽאֲלָפִ֑֔ים לְאֹהֲבַ֖י וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י מִצְוֹתוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·śeh ḥe·seḏ la·’ă·lā·p̄îm lə·’ō·hă·ḇay ū·lə·šō·mə·rê miṣ·wō·ṯō
verses.literal: but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments

verses.original: לֹ֥א תִשָּׂ֛א אֶת־ שֵֽׁם־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לַשָּׁ֑וְא כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יְנַקֶּה֙ יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ יִשָּׂ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ לַשָּֽׁוְא׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō ṯiś·śā ’eṯ- šêm- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā laš·šāw kî lō yə·naq·qeh Yah·weh ’êṯ ’ă·šer- yiś·śā ’eṯ- šə·mōw laš·šāw
verses.literal: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain

verses.original: שָׁמ֣֛וֹר אֶת־ י֥וֹם֩ הַשַּׁבָּ֖֨ת לְקַדְּשׁ֑֜וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖֣׀ יְהוָ֥֣ה אֱלֹהֶֽ֗יךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·mō·wr ’eṯ- yō·wm haš·šab·bå̄ṯ lə·qad·də·šōw ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wə·ḵā Yah·weh ʾɛ̆·lō·hɛ·ḵå̄
verses.literal: Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy as the LORD your God has commanded you

verses.transliteration: šê·šeṯ yā·mîm ta·‘ă·ḇōḏ wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā kå̄l- mə·laḵ·te·ḵā
verses.literal: Six days you shall labor and do all your work

verses.original: וְי֙וֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜֔י שַׁבָּ֖֣ת׀ לַיהוָ֣֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֑֗יךָ לֹ֣א תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כָל־ מְלָאכָ֡ה אַתָּ֣ה וּבִנְךָֽ־ וּבִתֶּ֣ךָ וְעַבְדְּךָֽ־ וַ֠אֲמָתֶךָ וְשׁוֹרְךָ֨ וַחֲמֹֽרְךָ֜ וְכָל־ בְּהֶמְתֶּ֗ךָ וְגֵֽרְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ לְמַ֗עַן יָנ֛וּחַ עַבְדְּךָ֥ וַאֲמָתְךָ֖ כָּמֽ֑וֹךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î šab·bāṯ laš·šēm ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lō ṯa·‘ă·śeh ḵāl mə·lā·ḵāh ’at·tāh ū·ḇin·ḵā- ū·ḇit·te·ḵā wə·‘aḇ·də·ḵā- wa·’ă·mā·ṯe·ḵā wə·šō·wr·ḵā wa·ḥă·mō·rə·ḵā wə·ḵāl bə·hem·te·ḵā wə·ḡê·rə·ḵā ’ă·šer biš·‘ā·re·ḵā lə·ma·‘an yā·nū·aḥ ‘aḇ·də·ḵā wa·’ă·mā·ṯə·ḵā kå̄·mō·ḵå̄
verses.literal: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God on which you must not do any work neither you nor your son or daughter nor your manservant or maidservant nor your ox or donkey or any of your livestock nor the foreigner within your gates so that your manservant and maidservant may rest as you do

verses.original: וְזָכַרְתָּ֞֗ כִּ֣י־ עֶ֤֥בֶד הָיִ֣֙יתָ֙׀ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔֗יִם וַיֹּצִ֨אֲךָ֜֩ יְהוָ֤֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֤֙יךָ֙ מִשָּׁ֔ם֙ בְּיָ֤֥ד חֲזָקָ֖ה֙ וּבִזְרֹ֣עַ נְטוּיָ֑֔ה עַל־ כֵּ֗ן צִוְּךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת אֶת־ י֥וֹם הַשַׁבָּֽת׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḵar·tā kî- ‘e·ḇeḏ hā·yî·ṯā bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim way·yō·ṣi·’ă·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā miš·šām bə·yāḏ ḥă·zā·qāh ū·ḇiz·rō·a‘ nə·ṭū·yāh ‘al- kên ṣiw·wə·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- yō·wm ha·šab·bå̄ṯ
verses.literal: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt and that the LORD your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm That is why . . . the LORD your God has commanded you to keep the Sabbath day

verses.original: כַּבֵּ֤ד אֶת־ אָבִ֙יךָ֙ וְאֶת־ אִמֶּ֔ךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן׀ יַאֲרִיכֻ֣ן יָמֶ֗יךָ וּלְמַ֙עַן֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔ךְ עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kab·bêḏ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·’eṯ- ’im·me·ḵā ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wə·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lə·ma·‘an ya·’ă·rî·ḵun yā·me·ḵā ū·lə·ma·‘an yî·ṭaḇ lāḵ ‘al hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lāḵ
verses.literal: Honor your father and your mother as the LORD your God has commanded you so that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you

verses.original: לֹ֥֖א תִּֿרְצָֽח׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō tir·ṣå̄ḥ
verses.literal: You shall not murder

verses.original: וְלֹ֖֣א תִּֿנְאָֽ֑ף׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō tin·ʾå̄p̄
verses.literal: You shall not commit adultery

verses.original: וְלֹ֖֣א תִּֿגְנֹֽ֔ב׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō tiḡ·nōḇ
verses.literal: You shall not steal

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ תַעֲנֶ֥ה בְרֵֽעֲךָ֖ עֵ֥ד שָֽׁוְא׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ṯa·‘ă·neh ḇə·rê·‘ă·ḵā ‘êḏ šāw
verses.literal: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor

verses.original: וְלֹ֥א תַחְמֹ֖ד אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֶ֑ךָס וְלֹ֨א תִתְאַוֶּ֜ה בֵּ֣ית רֵעֶ֗ךָ שָׂדֵ֜הוּ וְעַבְדּ֤וֹ וַאֲמָתוֹ֙ שׁוֹר֣וֹ וַחֲמֹר֔וֹ וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְרֵעֶֽךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ṯaḥ·mōḏ ’ê·šeṯ rē·ʿɛ·ḵå̄s wə·lō ṯiṯ·’aw·weh bêṯ rê·‘e·ḵā śā·ḏê·hū wə·‘aḇ·dōw wa·’ă·mā·ṯōw šō·w·rōw wa·ḥă·mō·rōw wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer lə·rê·‘e·ḵā
verses.literal: You shall not covet your neighbor’s . . . wife You shall not covet your neighbor’s house or field or his manservant or maidservant or his ox or donkey or anything that belongs to your neighbor

verses.original: אֶֽת־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֡לֶּה דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶל־ כָּל־ קְהַלְכֶ֜ם בָּהָ֗ר מִתּ֤וֹךְ הָאֵשׁ֙ הֶֽעָנָ֣ן וְהָֽעֲרָפֶ֔ל ק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל וְלֹ֣א יָסָ֑ף וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֗ם עַל־ שְׁנֵי֙ לֻחֹ֣ת אֲבָנִ֔ים וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh dib·ber Yah·weh ’el- kāl- qə·hal·ḵem bā·hār mit·tō·wḵ hā·’êš he·‘ā·nān wə·hā·‘ă·rā·p̄el qō·wl gā·ḏō·wl wə·lō yā·sāp̄ way·yiḵ·tə·ḇêm ‘al- šə·nê lu·ḥōṯ ’ă·ḇā·nîm way·yit·tə·nêm ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: The LORD spoke these commandments in a loud voice to your whole assembly out of the fire the cloud and the deep darkness on the mountain He added nothing more And He wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כְּשָׁמְעֲכֶ֤ם אֶת־ הַקּוֹל֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַחֹ֔שֶׁךְ וְהָהָ֖ר בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּאֵ֑שׁ וַתִּקְרְב֣וּן אֵלַ֔י כָּל־ רָאשֵׁ֥י שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֖ם וְזִקְנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·šā·mə·‘ă·ḵem ’eṯ- haq·qō·wl mit·tō·wḵ ha·ḥō·šeḵ wə·hā·hār bō·‘êr bā·’êš wat·tiq·rə·ḇūn ’ê·lay kāl- rā·šê šiḇ·ṭê·ḵem wə·ziq·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: And when you heard the voice out of the darkness while the mountain was blazing with fire all the heads of your tribes and your elders approached me

verses.original: וַתֹּאמְר֗וּ הֵ֣ן הֶרְאָ֜נוּ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ אֶת־ כְּבֹד֣וֹ וְאֶת־ גָּדְל֔וֹ וְאֶת־ קֹל֥וֹ שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הָאֵ֑שׁ הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ רָאִ֔ינוּ כִּֽי־ יְדַבֵּ֧ר אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־ הָֽאָדָ֖ם וָחָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mə·rū hên her·’ā·nū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ’eṯ- kə·ḇō·ḏōw wə·’eṯ- gā·ḏə·lōw wə·’eṯ- qō·lōw šā·ma‘·nū mit·tō·wḵ hā·’êš hay·yō·wm haz·zeh rā·’î·nū kî- yə·ḏab·bêr ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ḏām wā·ḥāy
verses.literal: and you said Behold the LORD our God has shown us His glory and greatness and we have heard His voice out of the fire Today . . . we have seen that a man can live even if God speaks with him

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ לָ֣מָּה נָמ֔וּת כִּ֣י תֹֽאכְלֵ֔נוּ הָאֵ֥שׁ הַגְּדֹלָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את אִם־ יֹסְפִ֣ים׀ אֲנַ֗חְנוּ לִ֠שְׁמֹעַ אֶת־ ק֨וֹל יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ ע֖וֹד וָמָֽתְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lām·māh nā·mūṯ kî ṯō·ḵə·lê·nū hā·’êš hag·gə·ḏō·lāh haz·zōṯ ’im- yō·sə·p̄îm ’ă·naḥ·nū liš·mō·a‘ ’eṯ- qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ‘ō·wḏ wā·mā·ṯə·nū
verses.literal: But now why should we die For this great fire will consume us and we will die if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any longer

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִ֣י כָל־ בָּשָׂ֡ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֣ע קוֹל֩ אֱלֹהִ֨ים חַיִּ֜ים מְדַבֵּ֧ר מִתּוֹךְ־ הָאֵ֛שׁ כָּמֹ֖נוּ וַיֶּֽחִי׃
verses.transliteration: kî mî ḵāl bā·śār ’ă·šer šā·ma‘ qō·wl ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥay·yîm mə·ḏab·bêr mit·tō·wḵ- hā·’êš kā·mō·nū way·ye·ḥî
verses.literal: For who of all flesh has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the fire as we have and survived

verses.original: קְרַ֤ב אַתָּה֙ וּֽשֲׁמָ֔ע אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְאַ֣תְּ׀ תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֗ינוּ אֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְדַבֵּ֜ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְשָׁמַ֥עְנוּ וְעָשִֽׂינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: qə·raḇ ’at·tāh ū·šă·mā‘ ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer yō·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wə·’at tə·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lê·nū ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer yə·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ’ê·le·ḵā wə·šā·ma‘·nū wə·‘ā·śî·nū
verses.literal: Go near and listen to all that the LORD our God says Then you can tell . . . us everything the LORD our God . . . tells you we will listen and obey

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ ק֣וֹל דִּבְרֵיכֶ֔ם בְּדַבֶּרְכֶ֖ם אֵלָ֑י וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי אֶת־ ק֨וֹל דִּבְרֵ֜י הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבְּר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ הֵיטִ֖יבוּ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ Yah·weh ’eṯ- qō·wl diḇ·rê·ḵem bə·ḏab·ber·ḵem ’ê·lāy way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay šā·ma‘·tî ’eṯ- qō·wl diḇ·rê hā·‘ām haz·zeh ’ă·šer dib·bə·rū ’ê·le·ḵā hê·ṭî·ḇū kāl- ’ă·šer dib·bê·rū
verses.literal: And the LORD - heard the words you spoke to me and He said to me I have heard - the words that these people have spoken to you They have done well in all that they have spoken

verses.original: מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֡ן וְהָיָה֩ לְבָבָ֨ם זֶ֜ה לָהֶ֗ם לְיִרְאָ֥ה אֹתִ֛י וְלִשְׁמֹ֥ר אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתַ֖י כָּל־ הַיָּמִ֑ים לְמַ֨עַן יִיטַ֥ב לָהֶ֛ם וְלִבְנֵיהֶ֖ם לְעֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mî- yit·tên wə·hā·yāh lə·ḇā·ḇām zeh lā·hem lə·yir·’āh ’ō·ṯî wə·liš·mōr ’eṯ- kāl- miṣ·wō·ṯay kāl- hay·yā·mîm lə·ma·‘an yî·ṭaḇ lā·hem wə·liḇ·nê·hem lə·‘ō·lām
verses.literal: If only . . . they had such a heart to fear Me and keep all My commandments always . . . so that it might be well with them and with their children forever

verses.original: לֵ֖ךְ אֱמֹ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם שׁ֥וּבוּ לָכֶ֖ם לְאָהֳלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lêḵ ’ĕ·mōr lā·hem šū·ḇū lā·ḵem lə·’ā·ho·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: Go and tell them Return to your tents

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֗ה פֹּה֮ עֲמֹ֣ד עִמָּדִי֒ וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אֵלֶ֗יךָ אֵ֧ת כָּל־ הַמִּצְוָ֛ה וְהַחֻקִּ֥ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תְּלַמְּדֵ֑ם וְעָשׂ֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh pōh ‘ă·mōḏ ‘im·mā·ḏî wa·’ă·ḏab·bə·rāh ’ê·le·ḵā ’êṯ kāl- ham·miṣ·wāh wə·ha·ḥuq·qîm wə·ham·miš·pā·ṭîm ’ă·šer tə·lam·mə·ḏêm wə·‘ā·śū ḇā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî nō·ṯên lā·hem lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: But you stand here with Me that I may speak to you all the commandments and statutes and ordinances you are to teach them to follow in the land that I am giving them to possess

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם אֶתְכֶ֑ם לֹ֥א תָסֻ֖רוּ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mar·tem la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ’eṯ·ḵem lō ṯā·su·rū yā·mîn ū·śə·mōl
verses.literal: So be careful to do as the LORD your God has commanded you you are not to turn aside to the right or to the left

verses.original: בְּכָל־ הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֜ה יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם אֶתְכֶ֖ם תֵּלֵ֑כוּ לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽחְיוּן֙ וְט֣וֹב לָכֶ֔ם וְהַאֲרַכְתֶּ֣ם יָמִ֔ים בָּאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּֽירָשֽׁוּן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵāl had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ’eṯ·ḵem tê·lê·ḵū lə·ma·‘an tiḥ·yūn wə·ṭō·wḇ lā·ḵem wə·ha·’ă·raḵ·tem yā·mîm bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer tî·rā·šūn
verses.literal: You must walk in all the ways that the LORD your God has commanded you so that you may live and prosper and prolong your days in the land that you will possess
